text: The BOSS GT-10 implemented catalogs and official documentation are authoritative; unsupported capabilities must be reported as unverified.
The verified GT-10 capability catalog does not contain Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Neural Capture, Cloud Reverb, or Shimmer. Do not imply that these features exist.
The lab has no verified Artist Profile or faithful-cloning database. Discuss general tonal characteristics only and do not claim an exact clone.
The GT-10 catalog includes multiple OD/DS types. Model choice is contextual; do not call one universally best. The current fixture has OD/DS type Blues OD but the block is OFF.
For more preserved pick dynamics, use moderate compression and avoid excessive sustain/level. Exact values depend on input level, guitar, and patch context.
The GT-10 has PREAMP A/B models and supports dual-preamp routing. The fixture uses MATCH Drive on A (Gain 55) and VO Drive on B (Gain 48), in Dual L/R mode.
The fixture uses Dual L/R Delay: Delay 1 is dotted eighth, Delay 2 is quarter note, both feedback 45; levels are 60 and 55 and high cut is 4.00 kHz.

The fixture uses Modulate Reverb, Reverb Time 9.0 s, Pre Delay 100 ms, Effect Level 40, Direct Level 100. Ambience emphasizes openness/depth like a distant ambience microphone; Modulate adds wavering hall-like character.
The fixture EQ is ON with Low Cut 110 Hz and Low Gain 0 dB. For mud, first diagnose excess low/low-mid energy and arrangement masking; make small changes and preserve ambience separately.

Noise suppression should be set only high enough to control unwanted noise; excessive threshold/release behavior can truncate sustain and dynamics. Diagnose gain staging and physical noise sources first.
Effect order changes what each processor receives. The fixture splits after COMP and OD/DS into PREAMP A plus DELAY on path A and PREAMP B on path B, merges, then reaches REVERB.

GT-10 supports Assigns and controller sources/targets documented in the local catalog. The fixture Foot Volume is ON with level 81, minimum 12, maximum 99, Normal curve. Guidance must not claim a change was applied.
Patch-scoped settings belong to a stored patch; System-scoped settings are global. Do not conflate the two. The fixture is User patch U29-1 named WC ALL-IN-ONE.
Workflow answers must follow the bundled GT Lab/BOSS documentation. If the retrieved facts do not contain exact steps, state that the steps are not sufficiently verified rather than inventing menus.

Output Select and connection point affect voicing. Line/Phones is intended for full-range destinations; amp-oriented selections compensate for guitar-amplifier destinations. Exact setup depends on front input versus return and whether GT-10 preamp/cab simulation is used.
Style guidance is not a documented fact. Build it from moderate, reversible adjustments; explain cause/effect; preserve the user's stated clean/definition/ambience constraints.
